messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي كأعداد صحيحة بأرقام 0-9 فقط، بلا فاصلة أو كلمة ملحقة، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"verse":36,"chapter":4,"text":"To them, Jeremiel the archangel answered, ‘When the number is fulfilled of those who are like you. For he has weighed the world in the balance."},{"verse":37,"chapter":4,"text":"By measure, he has measured the times. By number, he has counted the seasons. He won’t move or stir them until that measure is fulfilled.’”"},{"verse":38,"chapter":4,"text":"Then I answered, “O sovereign Lord, all of us are full of ungodliness."},{"verse":39,"chapter":4,"text":"Perhaps it is for our sakes that the threshing time of the righteous is kept back—because of the sins of those who dwell on the earth.”"},{"verse":40,"chapter":4,"text":"So he answered me, “Go your way to a woman with child, and ask of her when she has fulfilled her nine months, if her womb may keep the baby any longer within her.”"}],"book_code":"2ES","chapter":4}

response_format: JSON object with book_code='2ES' and verses array. Each item has chapter, verse, text_ar, review_notes_ar. Return exactly verse numbers 36,37,38,39,40 in this chapter.
